BudgetSource.description: Where the media budget's egress comes from.

oneOf.description: The engine's `stats` events.
Sew's forwarding estimate (stats missing or stale).

MailTls.description: How the SMTP connection is secured (`[mail.smtp] tls`).

oneOf.description: Plain SMTP; loopback relays only.
STARTTLS, required.
Implicit TLS.
Calls work (Sew's state after every start).
Voice is unavailable: joins and moves refused, live calls ended.
Everything allowed; full hints.
New camera leases refused; lower hints.
New camera and screen leases refused; lowest hints.
K2 grants create accounts; K2 signs the pass.
Local users and passwords.

A meeting-link session (session provider 3, made by redeeming a
meeting link). Never an install's provider.
Working.
Finished.
Gave up (a later run starts over).
Queries use the live index.
No usable index; a rebuild runs and searches answer `503 search_rebuilding`.

StatusAlarm.description: A status alarm. K2 shows each one verbatim.

oneOf.description: `db.ok = false`.
`jobs.dead > 0`.
`keys.provider_ok = false`.
`keys.current_month_ready = false`.
The keyring mirror is stale (or kind `none`).
A crypto-shred started but did not finish.
Old key files for shredded key ids were found and refused.
Keys wait for a re-wrap but no retiring KEK is loaded.
Search indexing trails writes by more than 60 s.
The search index is missing and being rebuilt; searches answer 503.
Three search index commits in a row failed.
Free disk under the search index is below its size plus 1 GiB.
The last good backup is older than 36 h (set by the backup engine).
The last backup failed (set by the backup engine).
The last restore drill failed (set by the backup engine).
The last good restore drill is older than 8 days (set by the backup engine).
GIF search is on but its provider key does not resolve or was refused.
A finite retention policy is set and no run finished `done` for 48 h.
Purged messages' search documents are still waiting after 24 h.
Three or more mail sends in a row failed over at least 10 minutes.
`digest.enabled` is on but `[mail.smtp]` is not configured.
A running export wrote no progress for 10 minutes.

A running account erasure made no progress for 10 minutes (its job is lost, overdue
or has failed for that long; a wait for an active recording is not stuck).
Voice is enabled and the media engine has been unreachable for more than 60 s.
The snapshot audit found voice state Sew did not expect.
The media engine reported a panic in the last hour.

More than 3 call key group resets install-wide in the last hour, or a call in reset
back-off.
A key removal was not activated by its hard bound in the last hour.
A key group rebuild ended in a new group or a reset in the last hour.
A client reported a roster mismatch in the last hour.
A stale-slot resync or a `peer_undecryptable` quorum in the last hour.
A client's bridge reported a misbehaving engine in the last hour.
Voice is enabled and the call DS or CA key failed to load.

The media budget tier has been `critical` for more than 5 min;
clears when the tier drops.
The recorder failed health for 60 s.
The transcriber failed health for 60 s.
The oldest untranscribed segment is older than 30 min.
A recording stopped on `storage_full` in the last 24 h.
Three auto-starts failed in 10 min for one channel.
A segment of an ungranted identity reached `sew` in the last 24 h.

A room that must record every call with two or more people could not: three
required starts failed in 10 min for one channel, or recording is required where it
cannot run (the recorder is not installed, `recording.enabled` is off, or the
governing App has `uploads: false`) in the last hour.

StatusBackup.description: Backup state in `status`. The backup engine fills it; absent until then.

age_ms.description: Age of the last good backup.

last_error.description: Why the last run failed, if it did (cleared by the next good one).

last_error_at.description: When the last failed run failed (additive).

last_id.description: The last good backup's bundle id.

last_kind.description: The last good backup's kind (`scheduled`, `manual`, …; additive).

lag_ms.description: Replica lag; absent in v1 (single node).

ok.description: Whether the database answers (`SELECT 1` within 1 s).

ping_ms.description: Round trip of the `SELECT 1` probe; absent when it failed (additive).

StatusDrill.description: Restore-drill state in `status`. The backup engine fills it; absent until then.

age_ms.description: Age of the last good drill (additive).

last_error.description: Why the last drill failed, if it did.

oldest_running_age_ms.description: Age of the oldest running erasure since it was requested; absent when none runs.

waiting.description: Erasures whose pass is done but whose kept rows are pending (`waiting`).

ffmpeg_available.description: Whether `ffmpeg` answered `-version` at boot (video posters need it).

StatusGateway.description:
`status.gateway` (0.7.1): the gateway's counters since this process started, the same
numbers as the `sew_gateway_*` metric families.

closes.description:
Server-sent closes by code (`"4000"`..`"4014"`, and `"stall"` for a writer that gave
up); every code is listed, zeros included. Clients must accept a key they do not know.

reauth.description: REAUTH outcomes (0.7.2, additive; zeros when an older server left it out).

sockets_live.description: Sockets with READY or RESUMED queued.

sockets_pending.description: Upgraded sockets not live yet (HELLO sent, no READY).

rate_limited.description: Closed `4008` (the install or the per-login limit).

timeout.description:
Closed `4003 identify_timeout`: no IDENTIFY in time, or its ticket or token was not
redeemed in time; or the READY build timed out (`4000`).

auth_failed.description: Closed `4004`: the token was refused, or names another member or credential.

timeout.description:
Closed `4003 identify_timeout`: REAUTH's token was not redeemed within
`identify_timeout_ms` of the REAUTH (the session left resumable).
Closed `4003 identify_timeout`: RESUME's ticket or token was not redeemed in time.

jwks_ok.description: Whether the JWKS cache holds keys (K2 only).

mode.description:
The install's stored identity mode. It differs from `provider` only between
`POST /mgmt/v1/identity/switch` and the restart that follows (additive).

restart_required.description: The mode was switched and this process still serves the old one; restart Sew.

switched_at.description: When the install switched from standalone to K2 (absent when it never did).

unlinked_local_members.description:
Active members still on a `local:` id. On a switched install they keep password
sign-in until K2 relinks or deactivates them (the transition state); absent on an
install that never switched.

oldest_due_age_ms.description: `now − min(run_at)` over due, unleased jobs; absent if none (additive).

queued.description: Jobs waiting (not under a live lease).

lazy_creates_this_month.description: Keys created lazily at write time this month.

mirror.description: The keyring mirror block; absent from servers that predate it.

mirror_age_ms.description: Age of the last good mirror write; absent if never ok.

mirror_ok.description: Whether the off-box keyring mirror is current.

next_month_prepared.description: Whether next month's install key exists.

provider_ok.description: Whether the master key provider works.

resurrected_keys.description: Old key files for shredded kids, refused at open.

rewrap_pending.description: Keyring entries still wrapped under a retiring KEK.

oldest_pending_age_s.description: Age of the oldest pending name, seconds.

stale.description: Alarm: a pending write is older than the stale threshold, or kind `none`.

unknown_keys.description: Mirror entries that are neither local nor on the ledger.

failed_24h.description: Sends that failed in the last 24 h.

last_error.description: The last failure (at most 200 characters, never an address).

sent_24h.description: Sends accepted in the last 24 h.

tls.description: The connection security (absent when not configured).

oldest_pending_s.description: Age of the oldest stored, untranscribed segment.

rtf_1h.description: Realtime factor over the last hour.

overdue.description: A finite policy is set and no run finished `done` for 48 h.

search_pending.description: Purged messages whose search documents are not deleted yet.

shred_candidates.description: Scope-months waiting for a shred check.

index_bytes.description: Bytes of the live index on disk.

lag_ms.description:
How far indexing trails writes: `now − min(created_at)` over pending or running
`search_index` / `search_delete` jobs; 0 when none.

rebuild.description: Present only while a rebuild runs.

docs.description: Documents in the building index so far.

ca_kid.description: The CA key id; absent when the key failed to load.

ds_kid.description: The DS key id; absent when the key failed to load.

per_call.description:
One entry per live key group, sorted by `call_id` (Sew 0.7.1). No member, device, join
id or key material: what K2 needs to diagnose a stuck call without the mgmt socket.

removal_overdue_1h.description: Removals past their hard bound in the last hour.

resets_1h.description: Group resets in the last hour.

roster_reports_1h.description: Roster-kind reports in the last hour.

active_epoch.description: The last activated epoch; absent before the first activation.

awaiting_creator.description: The call waits for its first joiner to create the group.

backoff.description: The call is in reset back-off.

call_id.description: The call (its room name, as the key routes carry it).

generation.description: Group resets so far (0 for the first group).

pending.description: Admitted joins without a leaf yet.

rebuilding.description: The call is rebuilding after a `sew` restart.

resetting.description: A group reset is in flight.

StatusVoiceE2eeLeaves.description: Leaf counts by state in a [`StatusVoiceE2eeCall`].

VoiceEngineState.description: The engine as `status.voice.engine` sees it (`details.engine` of a voice `503`).

oneOf.description: Healthy.
Unreachable for `health_failures_down` checks in a row.
Draining.
Sew is resyncing from a snapshot.
The engine answered with an error, or the call keys failed to load.

drift_fixes_1h.description: Drift the snapshot audits fixed in the last hour.

panics_1h.description: Engine panics in the last hour.

version.description: The engine's version, from its last health answer.

since.description: Since when (the start of this Sew process while it has always been `up`).

VoiceMediaStatus.description: The video, DM call and media budget part of `status.voice`.

budget_source.description: Where the budget's egress comes from.

egress_mbps.description: The egress the tiers use (the engine's measured egress, or the estimate), Mbit/s.

engine_cpu_pct.description: The engine cgroup's CPU against its allowance; `null` when unknown.

VoiceStatus.description:
`status.voice`. Absent when voice is off
and was never configured.

media.description:
Video, DM calls and the media budget, as `status.voice.media` (the wire
types never use `flatten`, so these fields nest like `e2ee`). Absent
while voice is off.

secure_participants.description: Entries whose device is in the activated key epoch.

alarms.description: Every active alarm, sorted (additive). K2 shows them verbatim.

drill.description: Restore drills (the backup engine fills it).

exports.description: Exports running, queued and on disk (additive).

features.description:
The features this build has, sorted ([`FEATURES`]; additive). K2 tests a feature, not a
version. A flag is never removed or renamed once shipped.

gateway.description:
The gateway's counters since this process started (0.7.1, additive): IDENTIFY and RESUME
outcomes and server-sent closes by code. Absent from servers that predate it.

recording.description: Recording and transcription (additive). Absent while recording is off.

retention.description: Retention runs, pending policies, holds and shred candidates (additive).

voice.description:
Voice, the media engine and call keys (additive). Absent while
voice was never configured.
